title: Thai Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Thai-inspired stew made with tender beef and a variety of spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and red bell pepper; cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, fish sauce (if using), and brown sugar.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro (if desired).
